answer: Wander Quota Duty: thirty percent of each identity's epoch income must come from counterparties drawn by a tundra-wide VRF lottery outside its prior-sixty-epoch partner set - a forced wander. Income that never leaves a frozen pond of familiar aliases freezes to zero weight, however profitable the pond. A lotus may look whole while rooted in one pond; the quota forces rhizomes outward. A thousand clones all draw from the same shallow pond, so they cannot satisfy the quota without hiring outsiders at real market prices, which erases the arbitrage of faking.
